notes: core = installed by default (vetted: official vendor or top-reputation author, knowledge-first, skills.sh Gen/Socket/Snyk audits reviewed, local red-flag scan). optional = opt-in only, each with the reason it is not core. skip = researched and rejected; keep in docs so nobody re-adds them.

Official guide for building MCP servers (tool naming, schemas, evals).
Root-cause-first debugging method; most adopted engineering skill set.
User-invoked requirements interrogation before building.
Audits third-party skills before/after install.
Threat-model-first web hardening incl. privacy compliance (GDPR/CNDP-style).
Official Exa API reference (search, contents, Agent API, monitors).
PDF extract/merge/forms/OCR via local Python scripts.
Word create/edit incl. tracked changes.
Excel generation with formulas/formatting.
Local DOC/DOCX/PPT/XLS/PDF/EPUB to Markdown via anydoc (npx at use time).
Art-directed UI instead of generic AI defaults.
Official GSAP ScrollTrigger guidance for scroll-telling.
Official Docker compose wiring/debugging patterns.
Official Dockerfile build strategies.
Vendor-neutral Postgres schema/RLS/index/perf guidance.
Valid Obsidian-flavored Markdown (wikilinks, callouts, properties).
Official programmatic-video (React) guidance; renders locally, no media API.
Model-agnostic video prompting guide (knowledge only; no token needed).
Model-agnostic image prompting guide (knowledge only; no token needed).
Official Hugging Face Hub CLI reference (download/manage models).
